GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (7 May 46) LS
(SCAPIN - 929)
APO 500
7 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Confinement of Suspected War Criminal.
1. The following named Japanese, presently a patient in the International Hospital, Tokyo, will be apprehended as a Suspected War Criminal and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp).
NAME RANK | RANK
FUJINO, Masazo | 1st Lt.
2. The above named person will not be removed from the International Hospital, Tokyo, if his present condition will not permit.
3. Pending removal to Sugamo Prison, adequate Japanese Police guard will be assigned to prevent escape and future suicide attempts.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
